paragraphs: Cousins Properties Incorporated (the "Registrant" or "Cousins"), a Georgia corporation, is a fully integrated, self-administered, and self-managed real estate investment trust ("REIT"). Cousins conducts substantially all of its business through Cousins Properties LP ("CPLP"). Cousins owns in excess of 99% of CPLP and consolidates CPLP. CPLP wholly owns Cousins TRS Services LLC ("CTRS"), a taxable entity that owns and manages its own real estate portfolio and performs certain real estate related services.

Cousins, CPLP, CTRS, and their subsidiaries develop, acquire, lease, manage, and own primarily Class A office properties and opportunistic mixed-use developments in the Sun Belt markets of the United States with a focus on lifestyle office properties in Austin, Atlanta, Charlotte, Tampa, Phoenix, Dallas, and Nashville. Cousins has elected to be taxed as a REIT and intends to, among other things, distribute at least 100% of its net taxable income to stockholders. Cousins' common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "CUZ." Cousins, CPLP, their subsidiaries, and CTRS combined are hereafter referred to as "we," "us," "our," and the "Company."
Our operations are conducted principally in the office real estate segment which we measure by geographical area.

We consider "lifestyle offices" to be well-located buildings that are modern structures or have been modernized to compete with newer buildings, are professionally managed and maintained, and offer a number and type of amenities that are in high demand by customers that are focused on the importance of the physical work environment in recruiting and retaining employees. We believe our "lifestyle office" portfolio improves our ability to renew leases and obtain new customers which results in consistently higher occupancy than the remainder of the office buildings in our markets. We do not consider the expression "lifestyle office" a classification of our properties in accordance with any standard listing criteria in the real estate industry. We, therefore, caution investors that our use and definition of "lifestyle office" may be different than the use and definition of similar expressions and traditional classifications that may be used by other companies.

Our strategy is to create value for our stockholders through ownership of the premier office portfolio in the Sun Belt markets of the United States, with a particular focus on Austin, Atlanta, Charlotte, Tampa, Phoenix, Dallas, and Nashville. This strategy is based on a disciplined approach to capital allocation that includes opportunistic acquisitions, selective developments, and timely dispositions of non-core assets, with a goal of maintaining a portfolio of newer and more efficient properties with lower capital expenditure requirements. To implement this disciplined approach, we maintain a simple, flexible, and low-leveraged balance sheet, which allows us to pursue compelling growth opportunities at the most advantageous points in the cycle. We utilize our strong local operating platforms within each of our major markets to implement this strategy.

During 2025, we acquired one office property, completed an offering of senior unsecured notes, and generated positive operating results in our property portfolio. The following is a summary of our significant 2025 activities:
•Acquired The Link, a 292,000 square foot lifestyle office property in Uptown Dallas, for a purchase price of $218.0 million.
•Sold our bankruptcy claim with SVB Financial Group for $4.6 million.
•Received repayment at par of the $138.0 million mortgage loan investment secured by Saint Ann Court in Dallas.
•Received repayment at par of the $12.8 million mezzanine loan investment secured by Radius in Nashville.
•Loaned our Neuhoff joint venture partner $19.6 million at an interest rate of SOFR plus 625 basis points.
•Issued $500.0 million of 5.250% public unsecured senior notes due 2030 ("2030 Notes"), generating net proceeds of $496.9 million.
•Repaid in full $250.0 million of our 3.91% privately placed senior notes at maturity in July 2025.
•Sold 2.9 million shares under our at-the-market stock offering program ("ATM"), on a forward basis, at an average price of $30.44 per share.

headings: General Risks of Owning and Operating Real Estate
Our ownership of commercial real estate involves a number of risks, the effects of which could adversely affect our business.
Any additional indebtedness incurred may have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.
Covenants contained in our Credit Facility, senior unsecured notes, term loans, and mortgages could restrict our operational flexibility, which could adversely affect our results of operations.
Our degree of leverage could limit our ability to obtain additional financing or affect the market price of our securities.
Adverse changes to our credit ratings could limit our access to funding and increase our borrowing costs.
Real Estate Acquisition and Development Risks
We face risks associated with operating property acquisitions.
We face risks associated with the development of real estate.
Investment in Real Estate Debt Risks
Our investments in real estate debt face prepayment risk and interest rate fluctuations that may adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.
We will face risks related to our investments in mezzanine loans.
The mortgage loans in which we may invest are subject to delinquency, foreclosure, and loss, which could result in losses to us.
Any failure to continue to qualify as a REIT for federal income tax purposes could have a material adverse impact on us and our stockholders.
paragraphs: Below are the risks we believe investors should consider carefully in evaluating an investment in our securities.

General economic and market risks. In a general economic decline or recessionary climate, our commercial real estate assets may not generate sufficient cash to pay expenses, service debt, or cover operational, improvement, or maintenance costs, and, as a result, our results of operations and cash flows may be adversely affected. Factors that may adversely affect the economic performance and value of our properties include, among other things:
•changes or volatility within the national, regional, and local economic climate, including dislocations and volatility in the capital markets;
•Risks associated with real estate assets, including:

•competition from other available properties and other local real estate conditions such as an oversupply of rentable space caused by increased development of new properties, a reduction in demand for rentable space caused by a change in the preferences and requirements of our tenants (including space usage), such as work-from-home practices and utilization of open workspaces or "co-working" space, or local economic conditions decreasing the desirability of our locations,
•the financial condition of our tenants, including potential adverse effects from the bankruptcy or insolvency of one or more major tenants,

paragraphs: Our strategy is to create value for our stockholders through ownership of the premier office portfolio in Sun Belt markets of the United States, with a particular focus on Austin, Atlanta, Charlotte, Tampa, Phoenix, Dallas, and Nashville. This strategy is based on a disciplined approach to capital allocation that includes opportunistic acquisitions, selective development, and timely dispositions of non-core assets, with a goal of maintaining a portfolio of newer and more efficient properties with lower capital expenditure requirements. To implement this disciplined approach, we maintain a simple, flexible, and low-leveraged balance sheet, which allows us to pursue compelling growth opportunities at the most advantageous points in the cycle. We utilize our strong local operating platforms within each of our major markets to implement this strategy.

During 2025, we completed the strategic acquisition of an operating property, The Link, a 292,000 square foot lifestyle office property in Uptown Dallas, for a purchase price of $218.0 million. We also received repayment at par for two investments in real estate debt, secured by interests, respectively in Saint Ann Court in Dallas and Radius in Nashville of $138.0 million and $12.8 million, respectively, as well as loaned our Neuhoff joint venture partner $19.6 million at an interest rate of SOFR plus 625 basis points which the partner used to fund their portion of the joint venture loan repayment. Finally, we sold our bankruptcy claim with SVB Financial group for $4.6 million.

During 2025, we completed an offering of the public senior notes maturing in 2030 generating net proceeds of $496.9 million to fund the acquisition of the Link and to pay off $250 million of privately placed senior notes. In conjunction with our loan to our joint venture partner mentioned above, the joint venture amended its existing Neuhoff construction loan, repaying $39.2 million of the outstanding principal, extending the maturity date to September 2026, and lowering the spread over SOFR to 300 basis points from 345 basis points. The joint venture has an option to extend the maturity date an additional 12 months, subject to conditions. Additionally, we sold 2.9 million shares under Forward Sales contracts at an average price of $30.44 per share. The future net settlement proceeds will be $88.5 million.

During 2025, we leased a total of 2.1 million square feet of office space. Our office operating portfolio was 90.7% percent leased as of December 31, 2025 and the weighted average economic occupancy during the fourth quarter of 2025 was 88.3%. In 2025, the weighted average net effective rent per square foot, representing base rent excluding operating expense reimbursements and leasing costs, for leases with a term greater than one year, was $25.86 per square foot. Cash-basis net effective rent per square foot increased 3.5% on spaces that had been previously occupied in the past year. Cash-basis net effective rent represents net rent at the end of the term paid under the prior lease compared to the net rent at the beginning of the term paid under the current lease. Our same property net operating income for the year increased 2.4% on a straight-line basis and increased 0.9% on a cash-basis.

We believe the Sun Belt, and in particular the seven Sun Belt markets listed above, will continue to outperform the broader office sector evidenced by a clear bifurcation between Sun Belt and Gateway market fundamentals. In addition, as the flight to quality trend accelerates among office users, we believe our trophy portfolio is well positioned to benefit from, and ultimately outperform in, the current real estate environment.

paragraphs: Cousins Properties Incorporated (the "Registrant" or "Cousins"), 一間Georgia公司, 是一間完全整合、自營、自管的不動產投資信託 ("REIT"). Cousins透過Cousins Properties LP ("CPLP")進行幾乎所有業務. Cousins持有CPLP超過99%的股權, 並將CPLP合併入帳. CPLP完全擁有Cousins TRS Services LLC ("CTRS"), 一間課稅實體, 用以擁有並管理其自身的不動產投資組合, 並執行某些與不動產相關的服務.

Cousins, CPLP, CTRS及其子公司主要開發、取得、出租、管理及擁有美國Sun Belt地區的A級辦公室不動產及機會性混合用途開發項目, 並特別著重於Austin, Atlanta, Charlotte, Tampa, Phoenix, Dallas及Nashville的 lifestyle office 不動產. Cousins已選擇以REIT方式課稅, 並意圖, 其他事項除外, 將至少100%的淨課稅所得分配給股東. Cousins的普通股於紐約證券交易所交易, 代碼為"CUZ." Cousins, CPLP, 其子公司及CTRS合稱為"we," "us," "our," 及"Company."
我們的業務主要在辦公室不動產投資分部進行, 並以地理區域作為衡量標準.

我們將"lifestyle office"視為位於優越地段的現代建築物或已現代化以與較新的建築物競爭, 並由專業團隊管理與維護, 並提供多樣且受歡迎的設施, 這些設施對重視實體工作環境在招募與留住員工方面有高需求的客戶而言極具吸引力. 我們相信我們的"lifestyle office"投資組合提升了我們續約租賃及獲得新客戶的能力, 進而使我們在市場中的佔有率持續高於其他辦公室建築物. 我們不認為"lifestyle office"這個詞彙符合不動產產業中任何標準的分類標準. 我們因此提醒投資者, 我們對"lifestyle office"的使用與定義可能與其他公司使用的類似詞彙及傳統分類不同.

我們的策略是透過擁有美國Sun Belt地區首選的辦公室投資組合, 創造對股東的價值, 特別著重於Austin, Atlanta, Charlotte, Tampa, Phoenix, Dallas及Nashville. 這個策略基於對資本配置的嚴謹方法, 包括機會性收購、選擇性開發及時機性處置非核心資產, 並以維持較新且更有效率的投資組合, 並降低資本支出需求為目標. 為實現這個嚴謹方法, 我們維持簡單、靈活且低槓桿的資產負債表, 使我們能在週期中最有利的時點追求有吸引力的成長機會. 我們利用在各主要市場的強大本地營運平台來執行此策略.
2025年, 我們取得了一處辦公室不動產, 完成了一次高級無擔保債券發行, 並在不動產投資組閤中產生了正向營運成果. 以下為我們2025年重大活動的總結:
•取得位於達拉斯Uptown地區的The Link, 一處292,000平方英呎的lifestyle office不動產, 購買價格為2億1800萬美元.
•出售我們與SVB Financial Group的破產求償權, 獲得460萬美元.
•收到聖安法院（Saint Ann Court）位於達拉斯的抵押貸款投資本金償還金額為 138.0 百萬美元。
•收到位於納什維爾的 Radius 抵押貸款投資本金償還金額為 12.8 百萬美元。
•向 Neuhoff 合資夥伴貸款 19.6 百萬美元，利率為 SOFR 加 625 基點。
•發行 500.0 百萬美元 5.250% 公開無擔保高級債券，到期日為 2030 年（"2030 債券"），產生淨資金 496.9 百萬美元。
•於 2025 年 7 月到期時，償還 250.0 百萬美元 3.91% 私募發行高級債券。
•出售 2.9 百萬股於我們的市場現貨股票發行計畫（"ATM"），以遠期方式發行，平均價格為每股 30.44 美元。

paragraphs: 本公司策略為透過擁有美國南 belt 市場首屈一指的辦公室資產組合，為股東創造價值，特別著重於奧斯汀、亞特蘭大、夏洛特、坦帕、鳳凰城、達拉斯與納什維爾等城市。此策略基於嚴謹的資本配置方式，包含機會性的收購、選擇性的開發以及及時處置非核心資產，目標為維持較新且更有效率的資產組合，並降低資本支出需求。為落實此嚴謹的策略，本公司維持簡單、靈活且低槓桿的資產負債表，使本公司能於週期最有利的時點追求具吸引力的成長機會。本公司利用在各主要市場強大的本地營運平台來執行此策略。

於 2025 年，本公司完成戰略性收購一處營運不動產，名為 The Link，位於達拉斯 uptown 區，面積為 292,000 平方英呎的生活風格辦公室不動產，購入價格為 218.0 百萬美元。本公司亦收到兩筆不動產債務投資的償還，分別以票面價值償還，位於達拉斯的 Saint Ann Court 及位於納什維爾的 Radius，金額分別為 138.0 百萬美元及 12.8 百萬美元，並貸款給 Neuhoff 聯合投資夥伴 19.6 百萬美元，利率為 SOFR 加 625 基點，該夥伴用以償還其在聯合投資貸款中應負擔的部分。最後，本公司將與 SVB Financial group 的破產主張權出售，獲取 4.6 百萬美元。

2025 年，本公司出租總計 210 萬平方英呎的辦公室空間。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司辦公室營運資產組合出租率為 90.7%，2025 年第四季加權平均經濟出租率為 88.3%。2025 年，出租期超過一年的租賃，加權平均淨有效租金每平方英呎為 25.86 美元。以現金計算的淨有效租金每平方英呎，於過去一年曾被租賃的空間，較之前增加 3.5%。現金計算的淨有效租金代表在前一租賃期末支付的淨租金，與在現有租賃期初支付的淨租金比較。本公司相同資產組合的年淨營業收入，以直線基礎計算增加 2.4%，以現金基礎計算增加 0.9%。
本公司相信南 belt，特別是上述七個南 belt 市場，將持續超越整體辦公室產業，這由南 belt 與 Gateway 市場基本面明顯分化的證據可見。此外，隨著辦公室使用者對品質的追求趨勢加劇，本公司相信我們的冠軍資產組合將能從當前的不動產環境中受益，並最終表現優於市場。

headings: 擁有及經營不動產的一般風險
本公司持有商業不動產涉及多項風險，這些風險的影響可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
任何新增的負債可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
本公司信貸協議、高收益無擔保債券、定期貸款及抵押貸款中所包含的約束條款，可能限制本公司營運彈性，進而對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司負債程度可能限制本公司取得額外融資的能力，或影響本公司證券的市場價格。
本公司信用評級的不利變動可能限制本公司取得資金的渠道，並提高本公司借款成本。
不動產取得及開發風險
我們面臨與營運不動產取得相關的風險。
我們面臨與開發不動產相關的風險。
我們的不動產債務投資面臨提前償還風險及利率波動，這可能會對我們的營運成果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們將面臨與不動產投資平層貸款相關的風險。
我們可能投資的房貸貸款可能面臨逾期、法拍及損失，這可能會導致我們產生損失。
若未能持續符合聯邦所得稅目的的REIT資格，可能會對我們及股東產生重大不利影響。
paragraphs: 以下為我們認為投資人評估投資本公司證券時應謹慎考慮的風險。
總體經濟與市場風險。在總體經濟衰退或經濟不景氣的情況下，我們的商業不動產資產可能無法產生足夠現金用以支付費用、償還債務或覆蓋營運、改善或維護成本，因此，我們的營運成果與現金流可能受到不利影響。影響我們不動產資產經濟表現與價值的因素包括但不限於：
•國家、區域及地方經濟氣候的變化或波動，包括資本市場的動盪與波動；
•與不動產資產相關的風險，包括：
•來自其他可用不動產及當地不動產條件的競爭，例如因新開發不動產增加而導致可出租空間過度供給，或因租賃空間需求減少而導致租賃空間的吸引力下降，例如因租戶偏好的改變及需求的變化（包括空間使用方式），如遠端辦公實踐及開放式辦公空間或「共用辦公空間」的使用，或地方經濟條件降低我們地點的吸引力，
•租戶的財務狀況，包括因一個或多個主要租戶破產或財務困難而可能產生的不利影響
